assignments.name: alertText

nodes.name: Build Alert
nodes.notes: The alert names the failing node and links straight to the execution. An alert that only says 'something failed' gets muted inside a week.

nodes.name: SEND NODE GOES HERE
nodes.notes:
Replace with Slack / Telegram / Twilio and send {{ $json.alertText }}.

RULE: this node must NOT share a credential with the workflows it watches. If Google auth is what broke, the alert cannot go out through Gmail. That is the most common reason a correctly built alarm never rings.

nodes.name: Heartbeat Schedule
nodes.notes: Set this to the interval of the workflow you are watching. Then set period = that interval and grace = one more interval on the monitor side. Grace of zero pages you at 3am on one slow run, and then you mute it.

nodes.name: Heartbeat Ping
nodes.notes:
Dead man's switch. healthchecks.io, Cronitor or Better Stack all work. The monitor alerts when the ping does NOT land inside the window.

This is the only thing here that catches a trigger that simply stopped firing. An Error Workflow cannot: no run means no error.

Put this on the SUCCESS path of the workflow you are watching, not in this handler, if you want per-workflow granularity.
